alex_w: Posting an escalation from Acme — long-running streaming chat sessions drop mid-stream. Client hits a 401 around ~55s, then reconnects produce duplicate last tokens and a truncated final chunk. Also seeing token-level latency spikes (>2s/token) late in session. Billing flagged for duplicates.

maria_s: Can you paste the client code + auth rotation details and SDK version?

alex_w: Using python SDK 0.9.4 (async httpx iterator). Token rotation every 60s. Repro script below.

alex_w: ```python
# simplified repro
import asyncio
from redwood import StreamingClient

async def main():
    client = StreamingClient(api_key="...", sdk_version="0.9.4")
    async for msg in client.stream_chat(session_id="acct-123"):
        print(msg)

# token refresh handled externally at 60s
```

jordan_b: Do they refresh tokens mid-stream (i.e., replace Authorization header on reconnect)?

alex_w: Yes — they rotate at 60s. 401 occurs at ~55s though. Strange.

deploy-bot: runtime-deploy v3.2.1 applied 2026-03-01T04:20:00Z — token validation window tightened.

tim_ops: I ran the repro locally. I see SSE connection close with a 502 then client attempts reconnect and receives 401 on the new handshake. The iterator sometimes yields the partial last event twice after reconnect.

maria_s: Can you paste the raw event stream snippet and response headers? Need X-Request-ID if present.

alex_w: logs: ```
> GET /v1/stream/chat HTTP/1.1
> Authorization: Bearer eyJ... (rotated)

< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Transfer-Encoding: chunked
< X-Request-ID: rwd-xyz-0001

event: message
data: {"id":"m_987","content":"partial chunk 1"}

event: message
data: {"id":"m_988","content":"partial chunk 2"}

# connection drops
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway

# client reconnects with refreshed token
> GET /v1/stream/chat HTTP/1.1
> Authorization: Bearer eyJ... (new)
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< content-type: application/json
< X-Request-ID: rwd-xyz-0002
{"error":{"code":401,"message":"token expired"}}
```

jordan_b: That looks like a race between connection drop and token rotation. Two problems: (1) server returning 401 during handshake should surface a clear exception to the iterator (not hang), (2) reconnect dedup logic currently only removes exact event-id repeats — partial-chunk duplication can still occur.

maria_s: Agreed. Workarounds for customer: increase rotation window to 5m OR ensure client records last event id and ignores partial content with same id on reconnect. Also add retry backoff to avoid immediate reconnect during rolling validation windows.

tim_ops: I can reproduce the hang in our python sdk iterator: when a non-200 occurs during the SSE reconnect we swallow the error and keep the generator alive. Repro script attached.

alex_w: Customer is requesting urgent patch + billing credit for duplicate token charges. They lost a business demo.

maria_s: I'll open a bug and mark P1: sdk-streaming-py-midstream-401-emit-error-2212345678. Plan: (1) emit an explicit StreamingAuthError on mid-stream 4xx/5xx, (2) strengthen dedup to consider partial chunk IDs, (3) add an integration test with token rotate at 30s. ETA: candidate in 24h, patch release in 48h.

tim_ops: I'll add the repro to CI and include a test that simulates a 502 -> 401 handshake. Also will add server-side telemetry to detect token-expiration mid-stream spike (query by X-Request-ID rwd-xyz-0002).

deploy-bot: note: rolling back runtime-deploy v3.2.1 is on the table if we see widespread hits.

maria_s: Customer notified of workaround and temporary rotation increase. I'll kick off the patch and CC billing for potential credit.

alex_w: Thanks. Please post PR link and release notes here when ready. :thumbsup: :eyes:
